indicates the point of origin for the measurement
describes the resulting shape of the fire pit

items.question: What measurement from the center produces a circular fire pit?
premises: The prescribed measure is two eighth-parts.
This measure is taken from the middle point.
Applying this measure yields a round shape.
items.inference: Therefore the fire pit becomes circular when drawn with a radius of two eighth-parts from the center.
uncertainties: The use of a compass is implied from the preceding verse but not stated explicitly.
items.plain_english: Indeed, by taking two eighth-parts from the middle, it should become round.
